segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הַמְבַיֵּישׁ אֶת הֶעָרוֹם, הַמְבַיֵּישׁ אֶת הַסּוֹמֵא, וְהַמְבַיֵּישׁ אֶת הַיָּשֵׁן – חַיָּיב. וְיָשֵׁן שֶׁבִּיֵּישׁ – פָּטוּר. נָפַל מִן הַגָּג, וְהִזִּיק וּבִיֵּישׁ – חַיָּיב עַל הַנֶּזֶק, וּפָטוּר עַל הַבּוֹשֶׁת עַד שֶׁיְּהֵא מִתְכַּוֵּין.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «One who humiliates a naked person,» or «one who humiliates a blind person, or one who humiliates a sleeping person» is «liable, but a sleeping person who humiliates» another is «exempt.» If one «fell from the roof» onto another person, «and» thereby «caused» him «damage and humiliated» him, then the one who fell is «liable for the» indemnity of «damage,» since a person is always considered forewarned, «and exempt from the» indemnity of «humiliation,» since a person is not liable for humiliation «unless he intends» to humiliate the other person.

moves.summary: Humiliating a naked, blind or sleeping person creates liability
Falling from a roof: liable for damage, exempt from humiliation without intent

positions.claim: one who humiliates a naked, blind or sleeping person is liable; a sleeping humiliator is exempt
one who falls from a roof is liable for damage but not humiliation, which requires intent
